details: Update storm: the brush 'brush end' handler calls updateFromBrush() directly on every mousemove, triggering querySelectorAll DOM mutations and a full canvas redraw at 60fps with no debouncing or requestAnimationFrame coalescing. Stale closure: brushFilters capture pixel coordinates y0/y1 at brush time; after a resize triggers setupParcoords() and rebuilds scales with a new pcHeight range, those frozen pixel values map to wrong data extents, silently corrupting filter results.
